name: Kimi CLI / Kimi Agent
summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi agent surface for long-context research, document-heavy workflows, and Kimi Code CLI development tasks.
overview: Kimi CLI / Kimi Agent should be described as multiple Moonshot AI surfaces under one Agent category: Kimi web for long-context research and document workflows, Kimi Agent for task execution and planning, and Kimi Code CLI for developer-facing terminal workflows. Its value on To Play Claw is not generic coding alone; it is the combination of long-context Chinese/English research, document analysis, and a growing coding-agent path that needs careful separation from the chat product.

strengths.title: Long-context orientation
strengths.body: Kimi is strongly associated with long-context reading, research, document understanding, and multi-step information work.

strengths.title: Agent and research product surface
strengths.body: Kimi's public help materials describe agent-style workflows for planning and completing tasks such as research, website generation, slides, and document work.

strengths.title: Kimi Code CLI path
strengths.body: Kimi Code CLI is the developer-facing path and should be tracked separately from the general Kimi chat or web agent experience.

strengths.title: China-origin content fit
strengths.body: Kimi is especially relevant for Chinese high-quality content discovery, translation review, and bilingual developer knowledge workflows.

extensionModel.label: CLI
extensionModel.body: Kimi Code CLI is the relevant surface for terminal-based coding-agent workflows.

extensionModel.label: ACP
extensionModel.body: Kimi CLI documents an ACP agent server mode, which matters for integration with compatible clients.

extensionModel.label: Workflow
extensionModel.body: Kimi is strongest for long-context research, document workflows, and task planning rather than only repository coding.

extensionModel.label: Skills
extensionModel.body: Do not assume a stable SKILL.md-compatible ecosystem unless official Kimi Code docs or a reviewed source documents it.

recommendedStacks.title: Research-to-signal workflow
recommendedStacks.body: Use Kimi as a research and translation candidate source, then route publishable material through Signals review.

recommendedStacks.title: Kimi Code developer path
recommendedStacks.body: Track CLI, ACP mode, and editor/terminal integrations separately from the general Kimi web product.

recommendedStacks.title: Document analysis path
recommendedStacks.body: Use Kimi-related learning content for long-document reasoning and bilingual research workflows before recommending tool integrations.

limitations: Kimi web agent, Kimi Code CLI, Kimi Agent, and Moonshot API are different surfaces and should not be merged into one compatibility claim.
Official English documentation may lag Chinese product updates, so last-checked dates matter.
Third-party Kimi CLI guides should remain candidate-only unless official or repository-backed.
Do not show install commands unless they are clearly official and current; prefer official links.
